copy.curiosityHook: As daily privileges are tied to one man's favor, what tactics must Songlian adopt to navigate three entrenched rivals who already understand the game?
copy.description: In 1920s China, nineteen-year-old Songlian enters a powerful master's estate as a concubine, finding herself forced into a calculated rivalry against his three existing wives for status and household privilege.
copy.vibeSummary: A thoughtful, emotionally heavy drama centered on claustrophobic household rivalry and deliberate psychological friction.
copy.whyWatch: Zhang Yimou orchestrates a heavy, emotionally charged period drama exploring the oppressive costs of survival and scarce favor within an insular household.

allowedMaterial: Entering the household of a powerful lord
Forced competition with three wives for privileges and status
excludedMaterial: Any mention of character madness, executions, or deaths
Specific plot betrayals, illnesses, or third-act outcomes
The conclusion of the wives' rivalry and ultimate fates
